#!/usr/bin/env bash
# hardening.sh -- admin hardening DRAFT (read-only by default).
#
# Coverage: sudo, docker, lxd, cron, systemd user units, container
# environment, tmux, setuid/setgid binaries, root authorized_keys, sockets.
#
# Safety contract:
#   * Default invocation is a READ-ONLY detection report.
#   * --apply changes nothing unless --yes is also given; --apply requires
#     root.  Without both flags nothing is written.
#   * Every modification is first copied to $BACKUP_DIR and recorded in
#     manifest.tsv; rollback.sh restores from that manifest.
#   * The script contains no passwords and no private key material; key
#     files are only inspected by path.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

APPLY=0
YES=0
BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"
MANIFEST=""
CREATED=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: hardening.sh [--apply] [--yes] [--backup-dir DIR]

  (no flags)          read-only detection report
  --apply             perform reversible hardening fixes (root required)
  --yes               confirm --apply without an interactive prompt
  --backup-dir DIR    override backup location (default: /root/.hardening-backup)

Optional environment switches (only effective together with --apply --yes):
  HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP=1   remove the current user from the docker group
  HARDENING_REMOVE_LXD_GROUP=1      remove the current user from the lxd group
  HARDENING_DISABLE_NOPASSWD=1      comment out NOPASSWD/!authenticate sudo rules
EOF
  exit 0
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --apply) APPLY=1 ;;
    --yes) YES=1 ;;
    --backup-dir)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || fail "--backup-dir requires a value"
      BACKUP_DIR="$2"
      shift
      ;;
    -h|--help) usage ;;
    *) fail "unknown option: $1 (try --help)" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ] && [ "$YES" -ne 1 ]; then
  fail "--apply requires --yes (draft safety: explicit confirmation needed)"
fi
if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ] && [ "$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" != "0" ]; then
  fail "--apply must be run as root"
fi

# --- backup / manifest ------------------------------------------------------
atomic_manifest_append() {
  local target="$1" line="$2" tmp
  tmp="${target}.tmp.$$"
  { [ ! -f "$target" ] || cat "$target"; printf '%s\n' "$line"; } > "$tmp"
  chmod 600 "$tmp"
  if have sync; then sync -f "$tmp" 2>/dev/null || sync 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  mv -f "$tmp" "$target"
  if have sync; then sync -f "$(dirname "$target")" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
}

backup_file() {
  local phase="$1" p="$2" bpath mode owner group line
  case "$phase" in sudo|docker|lxd|cron|systemd|tmux|root_keys|sockets) ;; *) fail "invalid backup phase: $phase" ;; esac
  managed_path_ok "$p" || fail "refusing to manage unsafe path: $p"
  [ -e "$p" ] || return 0
  # A path is backed up at most once per phase.  This preserves the phase's
  # true pre-image even when more than one property is changed.
  if [ -f "$MANIFEST" ] && awk -F '\t' -v ph="$phase" -v path="$p" '$1==ph && $2==path {found=1} END{exit !found}' "$MANIFEST"; then
    return 0
  fi
  bpath="$BACKUP_DIR/phases/$phase${p}"
  if [ -f "$p" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$bpath")"
    cp -a "$p" "$bpath"
  else
    bpath="-"   # directories/sockets: record metadata only, no content copy
  fi
  mode=$(stat -c '%a' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  owner=$(stat -c '%U' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  group=$(stat -c '%G' "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  printf -v line '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s' "$phase" "$p" "$bpath" "${mode:-?}" "${owner:-?}" "${group:-?}"
  atomic_manifest_append "$MANIFEST" "$line"
  return 0
}

created_file() {
  local phase="$1" p="$2" line
  managed_path_ok "$p" || fail "refusing to track unsafe path: $p"
  printf -v line '%s\t%s' "$phase" "$p"
  atomic_manifest_append "$CREATED" "$line"
}

# --- apply phase ------------------------------------------------------------
fix_sudo() {
  local m f
  if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 750|700|755) ;; *)
      backup_file sudo /etc/sudoers.d
      chmod 750 /etc/sudoers.d
      log "fixed /etc/sudoers.d mode: ${m:-?} -> 750"
      ;;
    esac
  fi
  for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
    [ -f "$f" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "440" ] && [ "$m" != "400" ]; then
      backup_file sudo "$f"
      chmod 440 "$f"
      log "fixed $f mode: $m -> 440"
    fi
  done
  if [ "${HARDENING_DISABLE_NOPASSWD:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      if grep -Ev '^\s*#\s*HARDENING-DISABLED' "$f" | grep -Es '^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        backup_file sudo "$f"
        sed -i -E '/^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)/ s/^/# HARDENING-DISABLED /' "$f"
        log "commented out NOPASSWD/!authenticate rule(s) in $f"
      fi
    done
    if have visudo; then
      if visudo -c >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        log "visudo -c: syntax OK"
      else
        warn "visudo -c failed after sudoers edit; restoring from backup"
        "$SCRIPT_DIR/rollback.sh" --yes --phase sudo --backup-dir "$BACKUP_DIR"
        exit 1
      fi
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_docker() {
  local sock=/var/run/docker.sock m o
  if [ -S "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) ;; *)
      backup_file docker "$sock"
      chmod 660 "$sock"
      log "fixed docker socket mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
      ;;
    esac
    o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$o" = "root:root" ]; then
      if chgrp docker "$sock" 2>/dev/null; then
        log "docker socket group -> docker"
      else
        warn "could not chgrp docker socket"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "${HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    if have gpasswd && in_group docker; then
      backup_file docker /etc/group
      if gpasswd -d "$(id -un)" docker; then
        log "removed $(id -un) from docker group"
      else
        warn "gpasswd -d docker failed"
      fi
    fi
  else
    log "docker group membership not touched (set HARDENING_REMOVE_DOCKER_GROUP=1 to remove current user)"
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_lxd() {
  local sock="" c m
  for c in /var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket /run/lxd/unix.socket; do
    [ -S "$c" ] && sock="$c"
  done
  if [ -n "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) ;; *)
      backup_file lxd "$sock"
      chmod 660 "$sock"
      log "fixed lxd socket mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
      ;;
    esac
  fi
  if [ "${HARDENING_REMOVE_LXD_GROUP:-0}" = "1" ]; then
    if have gpasswd && in_group lxd; then
      backup_file lxd /etc/group
      if gpasswd -d "$(id -un)" lxd; then
        log "removed $(id -un) from lxd group"
      else
        warn "gpasswd -d lxd failed"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_cron() {
  local d m f
  for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$d" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755|750|700) ;; *)
      backup_file cron "$d"
      chmod 755 "$d"
      log "fixed cron dir $d mode: ${m:-?} -> 755"
      ;;
    esac
  done
  if [ -d /var/spool/cron/crontabs ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /var/spool/cron/crontabs 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$m" != "700" ]; then
      backup_file cron /var/spool/cron/crontabs
      chmod 700 /var/spool/cron/crontabs
      log "fixed /var/spool/cron/crontabs mode: ${m:-?} -> 700"
    fi
    for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "600" ]; then
        backup_file cron "$f"
        chmod 600 "$f"
        log "fixed crontab $f mode: $m -> 600"
      fi
    done
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_systemd_user() {
  local f
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    backup_file systemd "$f"
    chown root:root "$f"
    chmod 644 "$f"
    log "fixed unit ownership/perms: $f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f \( ! -uid 0 -o -perm -002 \) -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

fix_tmux() {
  local dir m
  dir="/tmp/tmux-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)"
  [ -d "$dir" ] || return 0
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
  case "${m:-?}" in 700) ;; *)
    backup_file tmux "$dir"
    chmod 700 "$dir"
    log "fixed tmux socket dir mode: ${m:-?} -> 700"
    ;;
  esac
  return 0
}

fix_setuid() {
  local out
  out="$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list"
  find /bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin -xdev \
    -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -printf '%m %u %g %p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort > "$out"
  log "setuid/setgid inventory written to $out (draft does not auto-strip bits)"
  return 0
}

fix_root_authorized_keys() {
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys m o
  [ -e "$f" ] || return 0
  # Secure the directory before touching the key file itself.
  m=$(stat -c '%a' /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "700" ]; then
    backup_file root_keys /root/.ssh
    chmod 700 /root/.ssh
    log "fixed /root/.ssh mode: $m -> 700"
  fi
  backup_file root_keys "$f"
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "600" ]; then
    chmod 600 "$f"
    log "fixed authorized_keys mode: $m -> 600"
  fi
  o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$o" ] && [ "$o" != "root:root" ]; then
    chown root:root "$f"
    log "fixed authorized_keys owner: $o -> root:root"
  fi
  return 0
}

fix_sockets() {
  local s m
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    case "$s" in
      /run/user/*|/run/gnupg/*|/run/*/gnupg/*) continue ;;
      /run/*) ;;
      *) continue ;;
    esac
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 660|600) continue ;; esac
    backup_file sockets "$s"
    chmod 660 "$s"
    log "fixed world-writable socket $s mode: ${m:-?} -> 660"
  done < <(find /run -xdev -type s -perm -002 \
    ! -path '/run/user/*' ! -path '/run/gnupg/*' ! -path '/run/*/gnupg/*' -print 2>/dev/null)
  log "note: user/gnupg/X11/tmp agent sockets are intentionally excluded; review manually"
  return 0
}

apply_all() {
  if [ -e "$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" ] || [ -e "$BACKUP_DIR/created.list" ]; then
    fail "backup directory already contains a manifest; choose a new immutable --backup-dir"
  fi
  mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
  MANIFEST="$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv"
  CREATED="$BACKUP_DIR/created.list"
  install -m 600 /dev/null "$MANIFEST"
  install -m 600 /dev/null "$CREATED"
  log "backup dir: $BACKUP_DIR"
  fix_sudo
  fix_docker
  fix_lxd
  fix_cron
  fix_systemd_user
  fix_tmux
  fix_setuid
  fix_root_authorized_keys
  fix_sockets
  log "apply phase complete; manifest: $MANIFEST"
  log "rollback with: $SCRIPT_DIR/rollback.sh --yes --backup-dir '$BACKUP_DIR'"
}

# --- main -------------------------------------------------------------------
log "=== hardening draft: read-only detection phase ==="
run_detections
if [ "$APPLY" -eq 1 ]; then
  log "=== apply phase (reversible) ==="
  apply_all
fi
log "done"

# rollback.sh -- restore state changed by hardening.sh --apply.
#
# Default is a read-only dry run that prints the restore plan from the
# manifest.  With --yes (and root), it restores file contents, modes and
# ownership, and removes files listed in created.list.
#
# Every path is validated by managed_path_ok() (fixed roots, no symlinks)
# before it is touched.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"
YES=0
PHASE=""

usage() {
  cat <<'EOF'
Usage: rollback.sh [--yes] [--phase NAME] [--backup-dir DIR]

  (no flags)       dry run: print the restore plan, change nothing
  --yes            apply the restore (root required)
  --phase NAME     restore only one phase (sudo/docker/lxd/cron/systemd/tmux/root_keys/sockets)
  --backup-dir DIR backup directory written by hardening.sh --apply
EOF
  exit 0
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --yes) YES=1 ;;
    --phase)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || fail "--phase requires a value"
      PHASE="$2"
      case "$PHASE" in sudo|docker|lxd|cron|systemd|tmux|root_keys|sockets) ;; *) fail "invalid phase: $PHASE" ;; esac
      shift
      ;;
    --backup-dir)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || fail "--backup-dir requires a value"
      BACKUP_DIR="$2"
      shift
      ;;
    -h|--help) usage ;;
    *) fail "unknown option: $1 (try --help)" ;;
  esac
  shift
done

[ -d "$BACKUP_DIR" ] || fail "backup dir not found: $BACKUP_DIR"

restore_manifest() {
  local manifest="$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" phase p bpath mode owner group rows
  [ -f "$manifest" ] || fail "no manifest at $manifest"
  rows=$(mktemp)
  trap 'rm -f "$rows"' RETURN
  if [ -n "$PHASE" ]; then
    awk -F '\t' -v ph="$PHASE" '$1==ph' "$manifest" | tac > "$rows"
  else
    tac "$manifest" > "$rows"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# verify_fresh_login.sh -- post-login verification (READ-ONLY).
#
# Intended to be run from a freshly established login session (SSH or
# console) to confirm:
#   * the login session itself works (session metadata sane, sudo usable),
#   * all hardening invariants still hold (same detections as hardening.sh),
#   * no drift versus the baseline captured by hardening.sh --apply.
#
# This script never modifies anything and never requires credentials beyond
# the current session.  It never embeds passwords or private key material.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
set -u

SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
# shellcheck source=lib/admin_lib.sh
. "$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/admin_lib.sh"

BACKUP_DIR="${HARDENING_BACKUP_DIR:-/root/.hardening-backup}"
TARGET_USER="${HARDENING_TARGET_USER:-k3}"
VERIFY_FAILURES=0

vfail() { printf '  [FAIL] %s\n' "$*"; VERIFY_FAILURES=$((VERIFY_FAILURES + 1)); }

session_checks() {
  printf '== fresh login session ==\n'
  printf '  [INFO] user=%s uid=%s tty=%s\n' \
    "$(id -un 2>/dev/null || printf '?')" \
    "$(id -u 2>/dev/null || printf '?')" \
    "$(tty 2>/dev/null || printf '?')"
  if [ -n "${SSH_CONNECTION:-}" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] ssh session from %s\n' "${SSH_CONNECTION%% *}"
  else
    printf '  [INFO] non-ssh session\n'
  fi
  if have sudo; then
    if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
      vfail "non-interactive sudo still works in this session"
    else
      printf '  [OK] non-interactive sudo is denied\n'
    fi
  fi
}

old_session_checks() {
  printf '== old-session and inherited-group checks (target: %s) ==\n' "$TARGET_USER"
  local current_session="${XDG_SESSION_ID:-}" sid uid user rest count=0 p groups g gid
  if have loginctl; then
    while read -r sid uid user rest; do
      [ "$user" = "$TARGET_USER" ] || continue
      printf '  [INFO] session id=%s uid=%s user=%s %s\n' "$sid" "$uid" "$user" "$rest"
      count=$((count + 1))
      if [ -n "$current_session" ] && [ "$sid" != "$current_session" ]; then
        vfail "another $TARGET_USER login session survives cutover: $sid"
      fi
    done < <(loginctl list-sessions --no-legend 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ "$count" -le 1 ] || vfail "$count target-user sessions exist; admin must terminate old sessions"
  else
    printf '  [WARN] loginctl unavailable; admin must independently attest old-session termination\n'
  fi
  for g in sudo wheel docker lxd lxc; do
    gid=$(getent group "$g" 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{print $3}')
    [ -n "$gid" ] || continue
    while IFS= read -r p; do
      [ -r "/proc/$p/status" ] || continue
      groups=$(awk '/^Groups:/{for(i=2;i<=NF;i++)print $i}' "/proc/$p/status" 2>/dev/null)
      if printf '%s\n' "$groups" | grep -qx "$gid"; then
        vfail "pid $p retains privileged supplementary group $g($gid)"
      fi
    done < <(pgrep -u "$TARGET_USER" 2>/dev/null || true)
  done
}

baseline_checks() {
  printf '== baseline drift (backup dir: %s) ==\n' "$BACKUP_DIR"
  if [ ! -f "$BACKUP_DIR/manifest.tsv" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] no baseline found; run hardening.sh --apply --yes first\n'
    return 0
  fi
  if [ -f "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list" ]; then
    local cur
    cur=$(find /bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin -xdev \
      -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -printf '%m %u %g %p\n' 2>/dev/null | sort)
    if [ "$cur" = "$(cat "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list")" ]; then
      printf '  [OK] setuid/setgid inventory matches baseline\n'
    else
      printf '  [WARN] setuid/setgid inventory differs from baseline:\n'
      diff "$BACKUP_DIR/setuid.list" <(printf '%s\n' "$cur") 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    /'
    fi
  fi
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys
  local key_baseline="$BACKUP_DIR/phases/root_keys/root/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$key_baseline" ]; then
    if cmp -s "$f" "$key_baseline"; then
      printf '  [OK] root authorized_keys unchanged since baseline\n'
    else
      printf '  [WARN] root authorized_keys changed since baseline\n'
      VERIFY_FAILURES=$((VERIFY_FAILURES + 1))
    fi
  elif [ -f "$f" ]; then
    printf '  [WARN] root authorized_keys exists but no byte baseline is available\n'
    VERIFY_FAILURES=$((VERIFY_FAILURES + 1))
  fi
}

log "=== fresh-login verification (read-only) ==="
session_checks
old_session_checks
run_detections
baseline_checks
if [ "$VERIFY_FAILURES" -ne 0 ]; then
  log "verify failed: $VERIFY_FAILURES fail-closed condition(s)"
  exit 1
fi
log "verify complete: fail-closed checks passed"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# admin_lib.sh -- shared read-only detection/reporting helpers for the
# hardening draft suite (hardening.sh / rollback.sh / verify_fresh_login.sh).
#
# Contract:
#   * Sourcing this file changes no system state and touches no credentials.
#   * Every detect_* function is read-only and prints a small report block.
#   * Writing operations live in the calling scripts and are always gated
#     behind explicit --apply --yes flags.
#   * This suite never embeds passwords or private key material; key files
#     are only inspected by path.
#
# shellcheck shell=bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2317  # detect_*/fix_* helpers are invoked by callers

# --- logging ---------------------------------------------------------------
log()  { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" "$*"; }
warn() { printf '[WARN] %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
fail() { printf '[ERROR] %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

have() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

in_group() {
  local g="$1"
  id -nG 2>/dev/null | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx "$g"
}

# Only paths below these roots may ever be managed, and symlinks are refused.
managed_path_ok() {
  local p="$1"
  case "$p" in
    /etc/*|/root/*|/var/run/*|/run/*|/tmp/*) ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
  [ -L "$p" ] && return 1
  return 0
}

# --- detection: sudo -------------------------------------------------------
detect_sudo() {
  printf '== sudo ==\n'
  if ! have sudo; then
    printf '  [INFO] sudo binary not installed\n'
    return 0
  fi
  if in_group sudo || in_group wheel; then
    printf '  [WARN] current user is a member of the sudo/wheel group\n'
  fi
  local f own m
  for f in /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d/*; do
    [ -r "$f" ] || continue
    if grep -Es '^\s*[^#].*(NOPASSWD|!authenticate)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      printf '  [WARN] passwordless/!authenticate sudo rule in %s\n' "$f"
    fi
    own=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$own" ] && [ "$own" != "root:root" ]; then
      printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:root)\n' "$f" "$own"
    fi
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$m" ] && [ "$m" != "440" ] && [ "$m" != "400" ]; then
      printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s (common: 440)\n' "$f" "$m"
    fi
  done
  if [ -d /etc/sudoers.d ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 750|700|755) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] /etc/sudoers.d mode=%s (expected 750/700)\n' "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: docker -----------------------------------------------------
detect_docker() {
  printf '== docker / container runtime ==\n'
  local sock=/var/run/docker.sock m o
  if [ -S "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s owner=%s\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}" "${o:-?}"
    case "${m:-?}" in
      660|600) ;;
      *) printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (common: 660 root:docker)\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}" ;;
    esac
    if [ -n "$o" ] && [ "$o" != "root:docker" ] && [ "$o" != "root:root" ]; then
      printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:docker)\n' "$sock" "$o"
    fi
  else
    printf '  [INFO] no docker socket at %s\n' "$sock"
  fi
  if have docker; then
    if in_group docker; then
      printf '  [WARN] current user is in the docker group (root-equivalent)\n'
    fi
    if [ -r /etc/docker/daemon.json ]; then
      if grep -qE 'tcp://(0\.0\.0\.0|\[::\])' /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  [WARN] docker daemon configured to listen on 0.0.0.0/[::]\n'
      fi
      if grep -q '"hosts"' /etc/docker/daemon.json 2>/dev/null; then
        printf '  [INFO] custom docker daemon hosts configured\n'
      fi
    fi
  fi
  [ -f /etc/subuid ] && printf '  [INFO] rootless-docker style /etc/subuid present\n'
  return 0
}

# --- detection: lxd --------------------------------------------------------
detect_lxd() {
  printf '== lxd ==\n'
  local sock="" c m
  for c in /var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/unix.socket /run/lxd/unix.socket; do
    [ -S "$c" ] && sock="$c"
  done
  if [ -n "$sock" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$sock" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [WARN] lxd socket %s mode=%s (lxd group is root-equivalent)\n' "$sock" "${m:-?}"
  else
    printf '  [INFO] no lxd unix socket found\n'
  fi
  if have lxc || have lxd; then
    if in_group lxd; then
      printf '  [WARN] current user is in the lxd group (root-equivalent)\n'
    fi
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: cron -------------------------------------------------------
detect_cron() {
  printf '== cron ==\n'
  local d m f own
  for d in /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly /etc/cron.monthly; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$d" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755|750|700) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] cron dir %s mode=%s (no world write)\n' "$d" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  done
  if [ -d /var/spool/cron/crontabs ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' /var/spool/cron/crontabs 2>/dev/null)
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] /var/spool/cron/crontabs mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "${m:-?}"
    for f in /var/spool/cron/crontabs/*; do
      [ -f "$f" ] || continue
      own=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      case "${m:-?}" in 600) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] crontab %s mode=%s (expected 600)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
      case "$own" in
        *:crontab|root:root) ;;
        *) printf '  [WARN] crontab %s owner=%s (expected <user>:crontab)\n' "$f" "${own:-?}" ;;
      esac
    done
  fi
  if [ -f /etc/at.deny ] && [ ! -f /etc/at.allow ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] /etc/at.deny present without /etc/at.allow\n'
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- detection: systemd user units / lingering -----------------------------
detect_systemd_user() {
  printf '== systemd user units / lingering ==\n'
  if ! have systemctl; then
    printf '  [INFO] systemd not present\n'
    return 0
  fi
  local u m f
  for u in /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system; do
    [ -d "$u" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$u" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in 755) ;; *) printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (expected 755)\n' "$u" "${m:-?}" ;; esac
  done
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [WARN] unit file not owned by root: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f ! -uid 0 -print 2>/dev/null)
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [WARN] world-writable unit file: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /etc/systemd/system /usr/lib/systemd/system /lib/systemd/system -maxdepth 3 -type f -perm -002 -print 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -d /var/lib/systemd/linger ]; then
    local u2
    for u2 in /var/lib/systemd/linger/*; do
      [ -e "$u2" ] || continue
      printf '  [INFO] lingering systemd user: %s\n' "${u2##*/}"
    done
  fi
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    printf '  [INFO] systemd user unit: %s\n' "$f"
  done < <(find /root/.config/systemd/user /home/*/.config/systemd/user -maxdepth 3 -type f -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: container environment --------------------------------------
detect_container() {
  printf '== container environment ==\n'
  local hint=""
  [ -f /.dockerenv ] && hint="${hint}docker "
  [ -f /run/.containerenv ] && hint="${hint}podman/containerd "
  if [ -n "$hint" ]; then
    printf '  [INFO] container marker(s) found: %s\n' "$hint"
  fi
  if [ -r /proc/1/cgroup ] && grep -qE 'docker|lxc|kubepods|containerd' /proc/1/cgroup 2>/dev/null; then
    printf '  [INFO] /proc/1/cgroup references a container runtime\n'
  fi
  local r
  for r in docker podman containerd nerdctl; do
    have "$r" && printf '  [INFO] container runtime installed: %s\n' "$r"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- detection: tmux -------------------------------------------------------
detect_tmux() {
  printf '== tmux ==\n'
  if ! have tmux; then
    printf '  [INFO] tmux not installed\n'
    return 0
  fi
  local dir m s
  dir="/tmp/tmux-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)"
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] tmux socket dir %s mode=%s\n' "$dir" "${m:-?}"
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] tmux socket dir %s mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "$dir" "${m:-?}"
  fi
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] tmux socket %s mode=%s\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
    [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] tmux socket %s mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find /tmp -maxdepth 2 -type s -path '/tmp/tmux-*' -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: setuid/setgid ----------------------------------------------
detect_setuid() {
  printf '== setuid/setgid binaries ==\n'
  local roots=(/bin /sbin /usr/bin /usr/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/local/sbin)
  local f m
  while IFS= read -r f; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [INFO] setuid/setgid: %s (%s)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find "${roots[@]}" -xdev -type f \( -perm -4000 -o -perm -2000 \) -print 2>/dev/null)
  local path_copy="$PATH" dirs dir
  IFS=':' read -r -a dirs <<< "$path_copy"
  for dir in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    [ -n "$dir" ] || dir="."
    [ -d "$dir" ] || continue
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$dir" 2>/dev/null)
    case "${m:-?}" in
      1777|0777) printf '  [WARN] world-writable directory in PATH: %s\n' "$dir" ;;
    esac
  done
  return 0
}

# --- detection: root authorized_keys ---------------------------------------
detect_root_authorized_keys() {
  printf '== root authorized_keys ==\n'
  local f=/root/.ssh/authorized_keys m o n x c
  if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
    printf '  [OK] no %s\n' "$f"
    return 0
  fi
  m=$(stat -c '%a' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  o=$(stat -c '%U:%G' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  printf '  [INFO] %s mode=%s owner=%s\n' "$f" "${m:-?}" "${o:-?}"
  [ "$m" = "600" ] || printf '  [WARN] %s mode=%s (expected 600)\n' "$f" "${m:-?}"
  [ "$o" = "root:root" ] || printf '  [WARN] %s owner=%s (expected root:root)\n' "$f" "${o:-?}"
  m=$(stat -c '%a' /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$m" = "700" ] || printf '  [WARN] /root/.ssh mode=%s (expected 700)\n' "${m:-?}"
  n=$(grep -vcE '^\s*(#|$)' "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf '  [INFO] %s non-comment key line(s)\n' "${n:-0}"
  if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
    while IFS= read -r c; do
      printf '  [WARN] key with suspicious comment in %s: %s\n' "$f" "$c"
    done < <(grep -vE '^\s*(#|$)' "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $3}' | grep -Ei 'backup|emergency|unknown|temp|draft' || true)
  fi
  while IFS= read -r x; do
    printf '  [WARN] non-root-owned file in /root/.ssh: %s\n' "$x"
  done < <(find /root/.ssh -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -uid 0 -print 2>/dev/null)
  return 0
}

# --- detection: sockets ----------------------------------------------------
detect_sockets() {
  printf '== sockets ==\n'
  local s m
  while IFS= read -r s; do
    m=$(stat -c '%a' "$s" 2>/dev/null)
    printf '  [WARN] world-writable unix socket: %s (%s)\n' "$s" "${m:-?}"
  done < <(find /run /tmp -xdev -type s -perm -002 \
    ! -path '/run/user/*' ! -path '/run/gnupg/*' ! -path '/run/*/gnupg/*' \
    ! -path '/tmp/.X11-unix/*' ! -path '/tmp/.ICE-unix/*' ! -path '/tmp/ssh-*/*' \
    ! -path '/tmp/tmux-*/*' -print 2>/dev/null)
  if have ss; then
    ss -lnt 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || $4 ~ /(0\.0\.0\.0|\[::\]):/ {print "  [INFO] listening: " $0}'
  else
    printf '  [INFO] ss not available; TCP listen inventory skipped\n'
  fi
  return 0
}

# --- runner ----------------------------------------------------------------
run_detections() {
  local out warns
  out=$(detect_sudo; detect_docker; detect_lxd; detect_cron; detect_systemd_user; detect_container; detect_tmux; detect_setuid; detect_root_authorized_keys; detect_sockets)
  printf '%s\n' "$out"
  warns=$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -c '\[WARN\]' || true)
  printf 'summary: %s warning(s)\n' "${warns:-0}"
  return 0
}
